periods.time: vol-10 ch-004, start of the semifinal second match

name.zh: 天音企图弃权污染决赛
name.en: Amane tries to withdraw and taint the final

periods.summary: At the start of the Ikki-Amane semifinal, Amane suddenly declares that he will forfeit, claiming that the audience's suspicion of his causality cheating makes any victory unacceptable. He then says he will cheer for Ikki in the final, causing the crowd to realize that his luck could make the promised Ikki-Stella final appear contaminated. Ikki remains calm, calls him by his old name Amamiya Shion, and exposes the jealousy and self-abandonment revealed by Tsukikage. Enraged that his past has been exposed and dismissed as childish resentment, Amane retracts the forfeit and chooses to fight.
periods.cause: Amane wants to hurt Ikki more deeply by making the final against Stella look decided by Amane's support rather than by the fighters themselves.
periods.outcome: Ikki prevents the withdrawal trap by provoking Amane into the official semifinal battle.
periods.significance: Turns Tsukikage's secret briefing into the trigger for the true Amane confrontation and protects the narrative purity of the promised final.
